purpose: Teach: 目録/一挙/チェンジ/扶養/誘致/下部/所在地/本編

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、商品目録を全面改訂しろ
lines.en: I want a complete overhaul of our product catalog.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative. Sharp attack. Each phrase lands with weight. No softening. The tone of someone accustomed to being obeyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新規顧客を一挙に獲得する戦略を立てます
lines.en: Understood. I'll develop a strategy to acquire a new customer base all at once.
lines.style: Composed acknowledgment. Slight pause after 'understood' to show he's already thinking. Steady, methodical pace. Demonstrates he's tracking both the order and the implications.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、組織体制を大胆にチェンジしろ
lines.en: I want bold structural reorganization of this company.
lines.style: Decisive, measured. Slight emphasis on 'bold.' Clear-eyed authority. Delivering instruction as fact, not suggestion. Leans forward slightly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の扶養家族手当も見直します
lines.en: Understood. I'll also review our dependents' allowance structure.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. Shows he's already thinking two steps ahead. No hesitation. Respectful but not deferential — a capable second recognizing a complex order.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 地方支店の誘致活動も強化しろ
lines.en: Strengthen recruitment efforts at our regional branches.
lines.style: Direct, unadorned. Each word purposeful. Slight pause before 'strengthen' to land the priority. The tone of instruction layered with expectation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。組織下部の意見も汲み上げます
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure we gather input from the lower ranks as well.
lines.style: Steady, thoughtful. Shows he understands the human side of restructuring. Measured pace. Respectful without subservience — he's demonstrating comprehensive thinking.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新支店の所在地を慎重に決めろ
lines.en: Choose the location for the new branch with careful deliberation.
lines.style: Measured, exacting. Weight on 'careful.' No rush in delivery. The tone of someone who knows premature decisions cost more than patience.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。本編の事業計画を策定します
lines.en: Understood. I'll draft the master business plan.
lines.style: Closing acknowledgment. Slightly warmer than previous responses — shows the meeting arc. Professional but signals readiness to execute. Steady, conclusive pace.
